description: NEW — Google Gemini native TTS via kie.ai: style-directed speech from natural-language direction, 30 named voices, up to 2 speakers, inline tone tags like [whispers]/[laughs] (flash model). ~4.2 credits per MINUTE of audio — cheaper than all ElevenLabs tiers. Simple mode: pass text (+ optional voice_name). Dialogue mode: pass speakers + dialogue_turns. model=flash is most expressive (keep expected audio <60s — quality degrades on long takes); model=pro is more stable for multi-minute narration. Downloads to kie/assets/raw/.

dialogue_turns.description: Dialogue mode: [{speaker_id, text}] in order; text ≤10000 chars, may contain tone tags

download_dir.description: Absolute directory to save into (created if missing). Defaults to the server's kie/assets/raw/.

estimate_only.description: Return the estimated credit cost WITHOUT submitting anything. Use before expensive runs (video, 4K, 1080p upgrades, layer splits).

max_credits.description: Refuse to submit if the estimated cost exceeds this many credits (overrides KIE_MAX_CREDITS_PER_CALL). Estimates come from published rates; kie bills the actual amount.

model.description: flash = Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS (most expressive, 200+ inline tags, best <60s; ~4.2 cr/min). flash-3.8 = Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS (NEW Sept 2026, same inputs, ~1.9 cr/min, ~40% cheaper per clip in live tests). flash-lite = Gemini 3.8 Flash Lite TTS (NEW, cheapest at ~1.3 cr/min; draft/bulk narration). pro = Gemini 2.5 Pro TTS (more stable long-form, ~4.2 cr/min). 3.8 prices are kie limited-time pricing until 2026-12-31.

sample_context.description: Overall tone/direction, e.g. "Audiobook style narration. Tone is gentle and inviting."

scene.description: Scene description, e.g. "A quiet, warm room with a fireplace crackling softly."

speakers.description: Dialogue mode: 1-2 speakers as [{speaker_id: "Speaker 1", voice_name, audio_profile?, accent?, style?, pace?}]. accent: Neutral|American (Gen)|American (Valley)|American (South)|British (RP)|British (Brixton)|Transatlantic|Australian. style: Vocal Smile|Newscaster|Whisper|Empathetic|Promo/Hype|Deadpan. pace: Natural|Rapid Fire|The Drift|Staccato.

text.description: Simple mode: the text to speak (single speaker). Inline tone tags like [whispers] work on flash. Ignored if dialogue_turns is set.

wait.description: Set false to submit and return immediately with the task_id (async mode) — then poll with check_task and fetch with download_result.

name: generate_gemini_tts
